Use case: identity-preserve. Production CHARACTER ATTACK SPRITE SHEET for LUIS MIGUEL MESSIAS in Brazilian pixel-art RPG O Segredo de Varginha. Image1 is DEFINITIVE identity/uniform: young male student, warm caramel skin, brown eyes, short dark cropped hair with clean low faded sides, short neatly trimmed dark beard and small mustache, friendly focused expression, WHITE shirt with GREEN raglan sleeves/collar and small GREEN anatomical-left chest badge. Image2 is ONLY crisp pixel-art full-body style/chibi proportions reference. Body wears DARK TEAL long trousers and mostly BLACK/WHITE sneakers with small red accents. Preserve identity exactly.12 COMPLETE whole-body separate poses in strict6columns x2rows, even cells, same scale and feet baseline, generous margins, real transparent background. Include handheld BLACK/SILVER MICROPHONE in right hand; all head/body/limbs/shoes intact. No external soundwaves/notes/effect trails/glows, no stage, no text/grid/floor/shadow. Source large enough to preserve crisp square pixel clusters and dark outlines; final each128x128cell.
TOP ROW variant0 RHYTHMIC RAP attack. Col1 anticipation facing EAST/RIGHT with microphone lifted near mouth and free hand pulled back, col2 contact facing RIGHT mouth open delivering forceful lyric with free arm extended pointing RIGHT, col3 recovery facing RIGHT with free hand back toward chest and mic lowered slightly. Col4 anticipation facing WEST/LEFT, col5 contact facing WEST/LEFT pointing toward LEFT EDGE, col6 recovery facing WEST/LEFT. Every face/nose on right half of row must point toward LEFT EDGE; do not reuse RIGHT-facing figure there.
BOTTOM ROW variant1 POWERFUL VOICE blast. Col1 EAST anticipation leaning back inhaling with mic near chin, col2 EAST strong contact leaning forward singing/shouting into mic toward RIGHT, free palm extended, col3 EAST settling recovery freehandlowered. Col4 WEST anticipation, col5 WEST forceful contact shouting toward LEFT with free palm extended LEFT, col6 WEST recovery. Genuine opposite-side drawings, not flip of asymmetric shirt badge. Four3stage sequences with distinct poses, identity/head size consistent and centered. No other characters, no smooth/vector/photorealistic shading, no blur. Whole complete figures drawn together, no anatomy assembly. Use current green school uniform, no black jacket or old costume.
